notes: Inbound SMB lead from Intercom widget. Use case: replace manual triage + agent note-taking with automated ticket summarization and structured outcome (fields: priority, category, suggested assignee). Interested in tool calling to surface quick actions (add comment, escalate, create follow-up task) via function calls. They tried hosted API with free credits; initial results promising on summary quality but concerned about per-token costs when attaching full conversation transcripts. Quote from CTO: "We want something that drops into our flow quickly — public cloud hosted API is preferred. No heavy infra yet." Wants SSO for internal admin portal and audit logs for compliance. Typical ticket volumes: 8-12k tickets/month, peak concurrency ~50 req/s during campaigns. Cost sensitivity high but willing to start small; potential to expand to Dedicated if usage grows. POC success metrics: 80% reduction in initial triage time, >90% API uptime, avg summary latency under 700ms for 3 conversational turns. SE engaged to validate batching and streaming options. Next deliverables: pricing detail for attachments, sample prompt templates, sandbox with function-calling examples and structured JSON output schema.
product_fit_summary: Workloads: ticket_summarization (primary), agent_assist (secondary), structured_output for CRM fields, and tool_calling to apply actions. Targets: median latency <700ms, tail p95 <1.5s for single-ticket summaries; throughput target 50 concurrent requests during peaks. Cost sensitivity: startup SMB budget; wants clear per-1000-token pricing and guidance on batching and prefix caching to reduce unit cost. Model prefs: open models or Redwood-curated weights acceptable; prefer hosted API to avoid infra ops. Routing/fallback needs: simple fallback to smaller model for non-urgent batches; no on-prem requirement. Security: SSO + audit logging required, KMS optional later.
